mapper.select: SELECT c.id as courseId, c.name as courseName, ROUND(AVG(cs.video_score), 3) as videoScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.exam_score), 3) as examScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.experiment_score), 3) as experimentScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.project_score), 3) as projectScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.homework_score), 3) as homeworkScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.sum_score), 3) as sumScore, COUNT(*) as scoreCount FROM ec_course_evaluation cs INNER JOIN ec_courses c ON (cs.course_id = c.id) WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name

SELECT c.id as courseId, c.name as courseName, ROUND(AVG(cs.video_score), 3) as videoScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.exam_score), 3) as examScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.experiment_score), 3) as experimentScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.project_score), 3) as projectScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.homework_score), 3) as homeworkScore, ROUND(AVG(cs.sum_score), 3) as sumScore, COUNT(*) as scoreCount FROM ec_course_evaluation cs INNER JOIN ec_courses c ON (cs.course_id = c.id) WHERE c.is_public = '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sumScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}
